scope: Three synthetic no-rake chip-EV games, F32, one worker, fresh Full artifacts. Cumulative SOL3/CKPT1 to SOL4/CKPT2 comparison; not external-reference, all-range, I16, NoRivers or 32-worker certification.
order: Six old/new census processes, then all24 solves in case order river/turn/flop, blocks0..3, old first iff case-index+block is even. After every solve completes, visit the same sample order for summary, saved-profile audit, decode-all, read-root, stream-write, plus checkpoint decode for warmups. 24 solves,24 audits,72 codec processes,24 summaries,6 census,6 checkpoint probes=156 processes. Bulky canonical retention is after solves; other retention still raises inherited RSS floors. No phase instrumentation.
quality: First native CLI check with NashConv strictly below0.04; original caps/cadences retained. Live and stored quantized profiles must both meet target. All finite; same-arm repetitions exact except explicit time/path/process metadata. Old/new numerical values may differ; report differences. No new target after observing candidate. Reject each live/saved deviation gain and NashConv below -1e-6 chips; retain original unclamped values. This absolute roundoff allowance is fixed before measurement.
codec_input: Each completed solve's immutable SOL is input to its three codec processes. Raw file identity, canonical blocks, root selection and rewrite bytes are retained; cross-repeat canonical ignores only wall_secs. No cross-version reads and no cross-arm raw payload equality requirement.
memory: Direct Rust root only; no subprocess expected from source. Native wait4 can include inherited pre-exec floor, so do not use native-new/native-old. For each measured root run U=native OS peak and L=sampled OS RSS maximum. If all values valid, complete samples show only root, and U>=L, max3(U_new)/min3(L_old) is a conservative OS-accounted peak comparison for these runs. Not exact physical RSS, population/median or phase peak. An unmet bound is inconclusive, not evidence of no improvement. Census, SOL/CKPT, source and all other retained payload reads can also raise the Python parent high-water inherited by later children. The solve-first order limits canonical-file contamination but does not remove that floor.
phase_timings: null: no final-source internal phase instrumentation in this campaign. Whole solve process includes initialization, CFR, periodic/final EVBR, all checkpoints, SOL, reporting and drops. Codec internal operations and audit load/eval have separate clocks. Prior source phase evidence is not relabeled as current.
retention: Original-byte showdown Store payload container only; distinct final-pipeline plan/result semantics. Retain every raw log/sample, source archive, original artifact and canonical file, deduplicating only identical bytes. Portable checker imports trusted checkout helpers, never retained code. Toolchain/Python executables are identity-only. Source-after is an executed live inventory comparison, not a separate filesystem snapshot.
budget: No cloud operations in this runner. Root reserves within remaining8USD before deployment; same4-vCPU16GiB x86_64 Spot boot, <=3h absolute lifetime with >=20min export/verification reserve. Outer service deadline and12GiB/swap0 containment required.
failure: Any command, target, artifact, identity, containment or check failure is terminal; retain available raw bytes and mark remaining stages skipped. No retries, replacements or resumed campaign. Every launch must fit its full timeout+20s inside the fixed measurement deadline. All screens descriptive and scope-limited; no R1 overall certification.
